query: INSERT INTO observations (entity_id,metric,value,unit,period,observed_at,source_id) SELECT entity,metric,value,unit,period,date::date,source FROM UNNEST($1::text[],$2::text[],$3::float8[],$4::text[],$5::text[],$6::text[],$7::text[]) AS v(entity,metric,value,unit,period,date,source) ON CONFLICT (entity_id,metric,period,observed_at,source_id) DO UPDATE SET value=EXCLUDED.value,unit=EXCLUDED.unit
